2026-08-07_jalr_dispatch_sites_RETRACTED.why_the_error_happened: ra captured at handler entry names the most recent jal on the execution path, which is the dispatch site ONLY if entry is by jalr. Entry was never verified to be a call at all: the handlers are entered by a proved jr (0x8005C108, trampoline) and by branches (0x80058EE8/0x80058F08, berry) -- no call, so ra was stale context, not a caller.
